name: F.I.R.
description:
F.I.R. is an Indian television sitcom first shown on July 31, 2006, on SAB TV. It is a story about a Haryanvi Lady Police Inspector. The story revolves around her and her sub- constables antics. The show is produced by Edit II Productions and is being broadcast Monday to Friday nights. The sitcom was nominated for the Best Sitcom category at the Indian Telly Awards in 2009. The sitcom is set in a police station.

On March 16, 2013, the show took a 20-year leap from 2013 to 2033 but from 8 July 2013, the setting has returned to the present.

videos.title: Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Officers at Iman Chowki are worried that an extremely honest Police Officer is getting posted there and all their corruption will come to an end. But a local thief, who gets mistaken for inspector Bajrang Pandey, takes over the role in the Police station and continues his role as an imposter. Watch how the station reacts to this fake inspector only on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Fir Registration
videos.overview: As soon as the locals in the area hear that the new inspector offers 50 rupees for filing a report, a huge mass gathers around the station. People are waiting in lines just to get their FIR registered. Will our fake inspector manage to continue his lies? Watch now on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Woman Beats a Man
videos.overview: A man rushes into the station to file a report against a woman who was beaten by her. He seems terrified at the idea of this woman. He claims that he by mistake splashed some dirt on her and in return she beat him black and blue. Who is this woman who beat up this civilian? Watch this hilarious episode now only on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Brahmachari Bajranj Pandey
videos.overview: Sub Inspector Chandra Mukhi Chautala finds out that Bajrang Pandey isn't as Brahmachari as he portrays. She sees him in a dhaba drinking beer and eating non vegetarian food. Our imposter inspector does a good job of covering all this up and escapes the drilling. Watch as hilarity ensues on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Mission Laila Majnu
videos.overview: Officers at Imaan Chowki decide to do an operation of highest priority. They decide on cracking down on couples in the park and call it mission Laila Majnu. How will this war against love turn out for our honest officers? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Inspector Gulgule
videos.overview: The two havaldaars at Imaan chowki are worried that they have no respect in the eyes of the local public and need to up their game to get what they deserve. They formulate a plan to climb up the social hierarchy. How will the plan turn up for Gopi and Gulgule? Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

videos.title: The Lost Buffalo
videos.overview: A man loses his buffalo called Mandakini and goes to the Police station to file a complaint. Gandotre and Gulgule get super confused at the man's story and ask himto file a report after 24 hours. Will this man be able to overcome the bureaucracy and file his report? Watch now on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Explosives In a Vegetable
videos.overview: An evil Villain has a plan to put explosives in a vegetable and use it against the civilians. Our team of efficient police officers is close by and keeping a close eye on all strange objects from strangers. Will our Inspector's love for Kaddu prove to be costly? Watch the entire episode on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Badnaam Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Our officers at Imaan Chowki are tensed that a recent survey has ranked their Chowki as the most inefficient Chowki in the country. Inspector Bajrang decides to make drastic changes and change the Chowki's reputation. They decide to crack down on all illegal activities. Watch now on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Passport Verification
videos.overview: A family comes to inquire about their update on the passport verification but our officers are in no mood to work. After taking a bribe of 400 rupees, the file finally moves a little forward. How does this entire experience pan out for the family? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Diwali At Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: The officers at Imaan Chowki are upset at the idea that they have to be out on duty during the Diwali celebrations. They had promised their family members that they would be home but the inspector orders them that there are threats according to the commissioner and everyone has to be on high alert. How will Diwali go for our bravehearts? Watch entire episode on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Honey is Missing
videos.overview: Famous Model Tara comes to file a report because Honey is missing. The officers at the Chowki are confused as to who and what is this honey and how is it missing. Our inspector's heart starts to flutter after seeing Tara. Will our officers be successful in finding Honey? Watch now on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Gopi's Nephew
videos.overview: Constable Gopi's nephew comes to visit him at the station. He wants him to save him from Eve teasing charges. He reminds uncle that his uncle too must have made a mistake in his past, so he must protect him this time. Will patriarchy win or can the man finally file his report against his wife's harassment.

videos.title: Lage Raho Chandramukhi
videos.overview: Sub-Inspector Chautala and Inspector Hanuman go out and watch a movie together. The movie of their choice seems to be Lage Raho Munna Bhai. The movie makes a huge impact on  Sub Inspector Chautala. She goes around and apologizes to all the criminals she beat up in the past. How long will this nonviolence last?

videos.title: The Forgetful Dancer
videos.overview: Our officers raid an illegal dance bar. They get hold of one of the dancers who pretends to be crazy and forgetful. She claims that she was kidnapped and that she doesn't remember anything after that. Officers take her to a mental Asylum to get an expert opinion on her. Watch the entire episode only on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Kuku’s Missing Chicken
videos.overview: A man named Kuku comes into the police station to file an FIR. He complains that his chicken has gone missing and insists that Jokila wrote his report. It appears he has a soft part for Jokila. Will the man find his chicken? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Terrorist Mix Up
videos.overview: A man's father goes missing and he comes to the police station to file a report.  Here he finds out that a famous terrorist was also on the run. Constable Gulgule takes the photos and gets them printed. Will the police be able to find the terrorist and the missing father? Watch now on Sony LIV.

videos.title: The Queen’s Speech
videos.overview: The Maharani and her translator come to the police station to file a complaint. The translator announces that the Maharani had an accident and has since lost her speech. But she was there to report her missing necklace worth 70 lakhs. Will they be able to retrieve it? Or our inefficient police officers stall on this call too.

videos.title: Man With No Arms
videos.overview: A man with no arms walks into the police station to file a report about his missing vest. Sub-inspector Chautala finds it the most tempting moment to lech at Hanuman Prasad and check him out physically. Watch as this hilarious episode unfolds on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Hanuman Prasad’s Challenge
videos.overview: Sub-inspector Chautala and Inspector Hanuman get into a gender debate where Hanuman insists that there will be a report where a man will come and complain about his wife-beating him. Fortunately for him, exactly that happens and a man comes in to file an FIR against his wife. How does this affect the challenge? Watch now only on Sony LIV.

videos.title: The Inspection
videos.overview: Commissioner Mukhtar Singh sends a letter to the officers at Iman chauki saying that he would be coming there for an inspection. This creates fear amongst all the officers. They fear that their corruption will get busted and Hanuman is worried his truth will be revealed. Watch how the team deals with an honest strict officer like Mukhtar.

videos.title: Con Man Asthana
videos.overview: A famous con man has been troubling the city. He marries young women, takes their jewellery and absconds. The police department receives complaints about him but they get a bigger shock when the famous Asthana challenges them openly through a letter. Can our officers catch this seasoned criminal? Watch now on Sony LIV.

videos.title: The Teasing Ghost
videos.overview: Mr.Cheda comes to the police station with a complaint that a ghost has been teasing his wife. The officers in our Chowki don't know how to deal with this unusual situation. They make Makkhan Singh practice on Inspector Chautala but the commissioner walks in on them. Watch this hilarious episode on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Gulgule has Cancer
videos.overview: Gulgule gets his report and finds out that he has intestine cancer. He becomes a changed man hearing this news. Gulgule begs Pandey to marry Chautala as his last wish. But before anything could happen, Chautala has to tell the truth. What was Chauatala's truth? Will marriage finally happen? Find out in this episode of FIR.

videos.title: Pandey Meets Nakaab Queen
videos.overview: Chautala wants to dance with Pandey. Gulgule arrests Onetwo who was making videos of ladies on the street. Indrajeet Chadha comes as Onetwo's lawyer with his bail. Pandey request Onetwo to introduce him to Nakaab Queen. Chautala comes up with an idea to complete her dream of dancing with Pandey.

videos.title: Not a Doctor
videos.overview: A doctor comes to file an FIR for his missing mobile phone. Upon investigation, the mobile phone is found out in his last patient's stomach. The doctor operates on him again but time forgets the handcuffs. The patient needs third surgery. Will he agree to get operated by the same doctor?

videos.title: Banana Peel
videos.overview: A man slipped on a banana peel, comes to the police station to ask for compensation from the man before whose house he slipped. Gulgule brings two men in because the peel was facing in two directions. Both men refuse to pay. What will Chautala do? Find out in this episode of FIR.

videos.title: Sweets Sweets
videos.overview: Ram Kathailu comes to the station to complain that someone has opened a sweets shop with the same name 'Ram Tahilu' right in front of his shop and he is losing business. Chautala asks them to prove themselves. But she must end this confusion. How will Chautala figure out the real and the fake?

videos.title: About Marriage
videos.overview: Chautala's father arrives at the station and asks for only one thing, for her to get married. Chautala reveals that she likes Pandey for her groom. Pappu comes to the station to file an FIR against a man who has broken a 20-year-old promise. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Chautala Resigns
videos.overview: Chautala gets into trouble after beating up the forest mister's driver. She quits the job and gets arrested. She finds herself sharing the same cell as Tappu. Tappu gives Chautala the offer to join his gang. Will Chautala switch sides and join Tappu's gang? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Treasure
videos.overview: When everyone in the station is enjoying their non-veg mean a man named Gauri Shankar brings a treasure box in. A man from the Nawab family who is also the owner of a chicken shop arrives a complaint about his missing hen. Chautala gets and idea to find out what is inside the treasure box.

videos.title: Printing Error
videos.overview: Pehalwan Dharti Pakad Khade Khade comes to Imaan Station with his problem, he keeps getting calls from hundreds of people inquiring about Dillon. All this started because of a printing error. Pehalwan and his uncle are troubled by this and seek help from Chautala.

videos.title: Chautala Dreams Of a House
videos.overview: W Developer comes to file an FIR on his tenant who is living in his flat for the last five years without paying any money. Chautala and her subordinates find this as a perfect opportunity to skim some money for themselves. Watch this episode to find out who they solve the case and get themselves some extra money.

videos.title: Valentine's Day
videos.overview: Everyone in the station is excited about Valentine's Day. Chautala asks Pandey out but he refuses. Two men come into the station to complain about their son and daughter respectively being involved in love and ask for help from the police. Will Chautala help the love birds or separate them? Will Chautala be always alone? Find out in this episode of FIR.

videos.title: Chandrika Sherawat
videos.overview: Chandrika Sherawat, a famous actress visits the Imaan Chowki for her training and Pandey has fallen head over heels for her. Everyone in the station is giving her all the attention and Chautala does not like this. She plans to do something that will reveal the true motives of the actress.

videos.title: Gopi Aur Hanuman Ki Anbhan
videos.overview: Head constable Gopi and Hanuman have a verbal altercation which leads to Gopi wanting to resign. Meanwhile, a tensed civilian has been making rounds of Iman Chowki to file his report against the corrupt builders, who forgot to put a bathroom in his flat. Watch as the team struggles to solve his problem.

videos.title: Hanuman's Stupidity
videos.overview: A troubled individual comes to the Chowki with his friend to file a complaint. He says that a drunkard has been troubling his servant and his wife every night. The Police summon the man and the man reveals that he has been doing so to force the complainant out of the house. He offers money in return for Chandramukhi and her officer's favours. Will Hanuman again spoil their plan or will the complainant be forced out his house? Watch entire episode one Sony LIV.

videos.title: Puncturewala
videos.overview: A famous businessman comes with a doubt that the puncturewala infront of his house purposely puts nails around his shop to puncture vehicles. Is he right in his assumptions and doubts? Or is it just insecurity? Watch as the team dives deep into the case. Watch exclusively on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Laalchi Hanuman
videos.overview: A worried rich business man comes to file a report against his to be son in law, who impregnated his daughter and ran away. This gives an idea to Inspector Hanuman, as he offers to father the child. This comes as a shock to everyone as he was supposed to be a Brahmachari. Will Hanuman now quit his job and become a rich son-in-law? Watch entire episode on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Holi Hai!
videos.overview: Its Holi time and everyone is super excited to celebrate it. Chandramukhi wants to celebrate it with Maakhan but he refuses straight away. This upsets Chandramukhi and she along with Gopi and Gulgule, plan something to trick Inspector Hanuman on the day of Holi. What is the plan? Only one way to find out.

videos.title: Say No to Dowry
videos.overview: A case of Dowry comes up at the Police station. A father and her daughter come up to file their report against the Grooms family.Chandramukhi gets overly involved in the case and is on a mission to get the wife justice. Watch as Chandrmukhi fights a cause on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Imaan Chowki is Sold
videos.overview: Golu Bakdi comes inside the police station and tells everyone to empty up the police station but later on, he comes to know that the person who sold him the police station was a thief and he is Hanuman's best friend. Chandramukhi puts both of them in jail. Will Hanuman Prasad and Guru be able to run?

videos.title: Missing Son
videos.overview: A mother complaints about her missing son Vijay Kumar. Chandramukhi promises that she will get her son. But later on, she comes to know that her son his dead. Will Chandramukhi find out the truth?

videos.title: Hanuman Prasand and The Burning Coal
videos.overview: A prisoner has been shifted to Chandramukhi's police station. Chandramukhi tries to impress Hanuman Prasad but she fails to do so, and takes out her anger on that prisoner. A baba comes and tells Hanuman that if he walks on burning coal Chandramukhi will get better. Will Hanuman Prasad walk on the burning coal?

videos.title: Married Woman
videos.overview: An astrologer tells Chandramukhi that she has the yog of getting married to the one she loves but she has to keep him away from the married woman. Meanwhile, a married woman calls at Imaan Chowki to file an FIR.  What will Chandramukhi do?

videos.title: Friendhsip Day
videos.overview: Gulgule has plans for friendhsip day and has some idea where he tells Chandramukhi to buy a ring and put it on Hanuman Prasads finger and this is how she will get married . Will Gulgule's plan work?

videos.title: An English Woman
videos.overview: A man arrives at the Imaan Chowki with his wife and daughter in law to lodge a complaint against his son whose planning to leave his daughter in law and marry an english woman. Will the officers at Imaan Chowki help him or add to his misery?

videos.title: Gulgule's Plan
videos.overview: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki to lodge an F.I.R that he was kidnapped and was forced to spend the night with a girl, listening to this Gulgule has a plan for Chandramukhi regarding how she can marry Hanuman Prasad. What is Gulgule's Plan?

videos.title: Late Night English Movies
videos.overview: A man lodges a complaint at Imaan Chowki against the cable man regarding the english movies that are played on TV late at night. But Hanuman Prasad Pandey is in favour of the cable man. How will Chandramukhi be able to sue the cable man?

videos.title: The Serial Killer
videos.overview: A man lodges a complaint against a shopkeeper for selling him shoes of different sizes. Officers at Imaan Chowki are tensed to know that a serial killer is on the loose and has killed a police personnel. Will they be able to find that serial killer? Tune in to find out!

videos.title: Hamuman Prasad's Due
videos.overview: A man lodges a complaint at Imaan Chowki against Hanuman Prasad Pandey that his dad's debt of Rupees One Lakh is due and he has to clear his dad's debt. How will Hanuman Prasad Pandey clear the dues? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: No More F.i.r
videos.overview: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki to lodge a complaint that he has seen a murder but Chandramukhi insists that she will not write the F.I.R because if there is one more F.I.R written in Imaan Chowki the Chowki will be closed. Will Chandramukhi solve the case?

videos.title: Chandramukhi Weds Hanuman?
videos.overview: A Jyotish arrives at Imaan Chowki and tells Hanuman Prasad that if he marries Chandramukhi he will become rich and prosperous, the same Jyotish also informs Chandramukhi about her future. What is the prediction done by the Jyotish?

videos.title: Hero Hanuman Prasad Pandey
videos.overview: A producer comes to lodge a complaint about an actor in his film and promises Hanuman Prasad to cast him as the hero, Chandramukhi tries her best to convince the producer not to cast Hanuman in his film. Watch the episode to witness what happens next.

videos.title: The Pinch
videos.overview: A man comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against the person who has pinched his wife in the Mela. Chandramukhi Chautala and team start investigating. Watch the episode to witness the case unfold.

videos.title: Lovers and The Postman
videos.overview: A boy and a girl who love each other, write letters to each other but the postman also loves the girl and never delivers the letters, they both get separated and the postman starts to get romantic with the girl. The boy comes to the station to lodge a complaint against the postman.

videos.title: Fraud Builder
videos.overview: Akhtar Armaan a shayar comes to file an F.I.R against a builder who sold him a flat located on the 20th floor but the building has a lift only till the 6th floor, because of this his wife leaves him. Watch the episode to know how Chandramukhi deals with this case.

videos.title: Chandramukhi's Oath
videos.overview: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki to lodge a complaint against his oppressive wife and he encourages Gulgule to stop Chandramukhi from slapping him. Chandramukhi takes an oath that she will never slap Gulgule. Will Gulgule be able sustain without Chandramukhi slapping him?

videos.title: Hanuman Insults Chandramukhi
videos.overview: Its Diwali time, Chandramukhi plans to get Hanuman Prasad to lit the joint rocket so that they will be united in the future. Hanuman Prasad comes to know about the plan and insults Chandramukhi. How will Chandramukhi deal with this insult?

videos.title: Exploitations Of a Boss
videos.overview: A man comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against his boss who is a woman, that she exploits her powers as a boss and tries to seduce him in the office. How will Chandramukhi deal with this unusual case? Tune in to find out.

videos.title: Fraud Employee
videos.overview: A business man lodges a complaint against his employee that instead of delivering the money at its destination he has bought properties for a girl. The business man suggests an idea to Hanuman Prasad to get his property back. Watch the episode to know what is the business man's idea?

videos.title: Training The Pickpocket
videos.overview: A man arrives at Imaan Chowki with the complaint of a pickpocket who tries to steal his wallet, Chandramukhi decides to get the pickpocket trained by Hanuman Prasad with an ulterior motive. What is Chandramukhi's motive?

videos.title: Lucky Customer
videos.overview: Two auto rickshaw drivers arrive at Imaan Chowki with a customer and they are fighting with each other for the customer as he is lucky. How will Chandramukhi solve this dispute? Tune in to join the laughter ride!

videos.title: Chopra Ka Jhopda
videos.overview: A man named Chopra comes to the police station to file a complaint against the builder who wants to forcefully build a shopping mall on his land. Watch the episode to know how Chandramukhi and team solve this case.

videos.title: Faulty Shampoo
videos.overview: A man comes to the police station to file an F.I.R against the owner of a shampoo manufacturer, as the man has lost all his hair due to the usage of the shampoo manufactured by his company. Watch the episode to laugh your hearts out!

videos.title: The Garbage Girl
videos.overview: A man arrives at the Imaan Chowki to file a complaint against a woman who throws garbage on him everyday while he's leaving for work, due to this he is about to loose his job since his boss requires him to wear spick and span clothes.

videos.title: 3 Days and No Night
videos.overview: A person comes to lodge an F.I.R against Raju Travels as he had booked a trip and Raju travels had booked the hotel only for 3 days and not the night due to which he had to sleep on the road with his wife. Chandramukhi and Hunuman Prasad are solving the case in their own unusual way.

videos.title: The Lost Girl
videos.overview: An actor named Karan comes to the police station to lodge an F.I.R as his girlfriend named Kavita is lost while they were roaming around in Ravanpur. Will they make a mockery of the case as usual?

videos.title: Get Married Chandramukhi!
videos.overview: Chandramukhi's father comes to the police station to convince her to get married and he starts getting men to the police station for her to choose. Her father keeps on blackmailing to convince her. How will Chandramukhi get out of this situation?

videos.title: Chandramukhi Wants to be Famous
videos.overview: Chandramukhi comes to Hanuman Prasad with a Mangal Sutra, but Hanuman rejects her saying he will marry someone who is famous. Chandramukhi decides that she will become famous anyhow. Tune in to witness Chandramukhi's road to fame.

videos.title: Naagin Chandramukhi
videos.overview: Chandramukhi comes to know that Hanuman Prasad is afraid of snakes, Chandramukhi tries to scare hanuman by dressing in a naagin dress with the motive to convince him to marry her. Will Hanuman Prasad give in?

videos.title: Landlord and The Tenant
videos.overview: A landlord wants to lodge a complaint against his tenant about him not paying the rent on time and the landlord gets a shock everytime he rings the bell of the tenant's apartment. Watch the episode to witness all the confusion and laughter!

videos.title: Pehelwaan Billu Bilori
videos.overview: A wrestler storms the police station and threatens Hanuman Prasad to kill him because he eve teased his girlfriend, Chandramukhi plans to get Hanuman Prasad attacked by the wrestler with an ulterior motive. What is Chandramukhi's motive? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Akade Pakde
videos.overview: A man comes to the police station to file a complaint against a man who instead of dropping him to his wedding destination kept on driving for 4-5 days due to which he missed his wedding. How will Chandramukhi and team solve this baffling case?

videos.title: Prabhhu Ki Leela
videos.overview: A man comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against a man named Prabhu who wants to kill him since the man doesn't want Prabhu to marry his daughter. Watch the episode to witness the case unfold in detail

videos.title: Hakdaar
videos.overview: Two couples file an F.I.R that one of their relative had died a few years ago and his property will go to his son when he gets married, the two couples bring two different men each claiming that the man they have brought is the one whose entitled to the property.

videos.title: Golden Class Tickets
videos.overview: A man comes to the police station to file a complaint that he bought expensive movie tickets expecting privacy but the person who sold them the tickets showed him the movie on a DVD player. Watch this hilarious episode now!

videos.title: Chaatwaala
videos.overview: A lady comes to the police station to file a complaint against a Chaatwala and a Doctor, whoever eats Chaat from the Chaatwaala has to immediately go to the doctor on account of stomach ache. What would be Chandramukhi and team's course of action now?

videos.title: Tendua
videos.overview: A man comes to file an F.I.R against a builder who has given him a flat in a forest area, where the buyer is facing problems because of the intruding animals, even a Leopard. Chandramukhi Chautala sends Hanuman Prasad to catch the Leopard.

videos.title: Chandramukhi Chautala Ka Darr
videos.overview: Chandramukhi informs Hanuman Prasad through Gulgule that she shot an inspector in the past for spitting paan on her shoes, the next day Hanuman by mistakely spits Paan on Chandramukhi's shoes. Watch the episode to know what happens next.

videos.title: Lambi Race Ka Ghoda
videos.overview: A man comes to file an F.I.R against a horse owner that he sent the horse used in Race Courses at his marriage, as a result the horse ran away as soon as he sat on it on the day of his marriage. Watch the episode to witness the team solve this hilarious case.

videos.title: Kiss In The Tunnel
videos.overview: A man with his wife comes to the police station to lodge a complaint against two suspected men, one of them has kissed his wife while they were on a train journey. With the excuse to solve the case Chandramukhi plans to kiss Hanuman Prasad. Will she succeed in her intentions?

videos.title: Role Play
videos.overview: A struggling actor arrives at the police station to lodge a complaint, Chandramukhi gets an idea to make the actor play her husband to make Hanuman Prasad jealous. Will she succeed or will she be caught in the act?

videos.title: Jimmy Jabaaz
videos.overview: Chandramukhi arrests a famous killer Jimmy and tells him to stay away from Hanuman Prasad. Jimmy breaks free from the police station and challenges Chandramukhi that he will kill Hanuman Prasad in the next 24 hours. Will Chandramukhi be able to save Hanuman Prasad?

videos.title: Dil Nahi Lagta
videos.overview: A man comes to file an F.I.R. against an agent who promised to send him to Dubai for a better job but that agent cheats and sends him to Madh Island. The agent lures Hanuman Prasad by promising him that he will send him to Dubai if he lets him go. Will Chandramukhi be able to stop Hanuman Prasad?

videos.title: Pyara Haanthi
videos.overview: A man comes to file an F.I.R against one of the pet company's owner that he has sent him an Elephant instead of a little pet he applied for. Company's owner defends himself by saying that the man had applied for a 'Pyara' pet so he sent him an Elephant named "Pyara". Watch the episode to witness all the confusion and fun!

videos.title: Murkh Baalak
videos.overview: A school teacher arrives at the police station to lodge a complaint against his student who harasses him by asking stupid questions. How will Chandramukhi and team deal with this case? Tune in to find out.

videos.title: Sautan Ki Saheli
videos.overview: Hanuman Prasad arrives at the Imaan Chowki after an absence of two days, on asking he doesn't answer clearly and says he's been in the mountains. Chandramukhi gets an idea to harass Hanuman Prasad. What is this idea?

videos.title: Budhapa
videos.overview: Hanuman Prasad reveals that he is 65 years old. A Saint had given him some medicines to look younger, but now as that Saint has died and all his medicines are over, Hanuman Prasad starts ageing. How will Chandramukhi deal with this?

videos.title: Manchali
videos.overview: A man comes to file an F.I.R for his missing wife. Chandramukhi plans to go out on a hilll station with Hanuman Prasad but he's reluctant. Will Chandramukhi be able to convince hanuman Prasad? Will the man find his wife?

videos.title: Khandaani Chappal
videos.overview: While travelling in the train a man looses one from the pair of his khaandani chappals and on the advice of the co passenger he threw his socond chappal as well but later he found that the first chappal is in the train itself, he wants to lodge a complaint against the co passenger for making him loose his Khandaani chappal.

videos.title: Kaamwaali Baai
videos.overview: Hanuman Prasad hires a woman for domestic help and develops romantic relations with her, this makes Chandramukhi jealous and she decides to enact a role play where she hires a domestic helper to make Hanuman Prasad jealous.

videos.title: Ugly Hanuman
videos.overview: Hanuman Prasad tells Chandramukhi that he is very handsome and she is nothing in comparison to him. Chandramukhi sends some girls to tell Hanuman Prasad how ugly he is, he gets very upset and decides to commit suicide. How will Chandramukhi save his life?

videos.title: Dheeraj Neeraj
videos.overview: Dheeraj comes to file an F.I.R that he's been working at Trivedi's house since he was a child because he loves Trivedi's daughter Utawli. But now Trivedi has fixed her marriage with someone else. Will Chandramukhi be able to get justice for Dheeraj?

videos.title: Lihaaz
videos.overview: Madan comes to file an F.I.R. against a man Lalit that whenever he goes out with his wife Katili, Lalit is already present there and greets his wife, one day Lalit takes 2 Lakh rupees from Madan and escapes. Watch the episode to witness the case in detail.

videos.title: Simple Dimple
