When they give the ring to Chandra she eats it and asks Hawaldars to perform for her. What will happen now?

Later on they visit the Baba who has also turned in Ghost and bites Billu and turns him as well. Now Gopi is the only one who remains human. What will happen now?

When Chandramukhiquestions him he tells her that he suffers from a illness in which he cannot see in night. What will they do now?

Chandramukhitakes all the files and leaves him. She reveals Handa's true color in front of the media. What will happen next?

What will happen next?

What will happen next?

Chandramukhicomes to know that Tiwari and Tripathi is the culprit. What will happen now?

Chandramukhi balances herself and beat Pappu. What will happen now?

What will happen now?

Chandramukhi thinks that an average man like Anna cannot have big connections and if he has he must be doing some black market work. What will happen now?

Chandramukhi reaches to his place and smartly arrests Anna and rascal. What will happen now?

Despite of Chandramukhi's warning, Gopi enters in Chowki in a woman's outfit again. What will happen now?

videos.title: Auto Drivers Auto Gets Stolen

videos.title: Dog Trainer Chaman Files a Police Complaint
videos.overview: Dog Trainer Chaman tells Chandramukhi that his best friend Raman has become a dog and also requests her to solve the case. Gopi, Billu and Chandramukhi are on their way to Kanpur Highway. Will the doctor be able to cure Raman's problem? Why is Chandramukhi taking interest in Raman's case?

videos.title: Chautala Gets to Know About Bhola and Darling
videos.overview: Gopi and Billu inform Chandramukhi about Chaman's wife who is enjoying a movie with an unknown person in the theatre. Chandramukhi succeeds in nabbing the unknown person and tries to collect more information about him. Chandramukhi gets to know about Bhola & Darling. Is Bhola in love with Darling? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Ab Kaise Hogi Shaadi
videos.overview: Mr Saxena and his daughter Filmy Saxena file a police complaint against Mr Khurrana who owns a Marriage Lawn. Mr Saxena requests Chandramukhi to help him out as Filmy's Marriage date is in the following week. Khurrana tells Chandramukhi that he will not give the hall to Saxena as he has already committed to giving the hall to someone else. Will Chandramukhi solve Filmy Saxena's case?

videos.title: Bhola Pandit's Master Plan
videos.overview: Senior Inspector of Imaan Chowki Bhola Pandit reveals his brilliant plan to Chandramukhi, Gopi & Billu. Khurrana comes across another client who wants to book the hall on the same date by paying more money. Will Bhola Pandit succeed in his master plan? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Pati Ka Baj Gaya Band
videos.overview: After getting Khanna punished, Chandramukhi gets a new case. Two women named Seedhi and Shakkar come to the chowki to file a complaint. Seedhi's husband has been missing from the past 5 days. He had gone to visit Nainital but hasn't returned since then. Will Chautala find him?

videos.title: Gappu Reveals a Shocking Truth to Chautala
videos.overview: Chappu's friend Gappu reveals to CC that his wife does not allow him to talk or go out with his friend Chappu. Chappu talks about the trouble that Gappu is facing after marriage. He gets arrested as he gave a final warning to Chandramukhi. Gopi is surprised to meet his friend Chaurasiya in Imaan Chowki.

videos.title: Fight Between Gappu and Chappu
videos.overview: Gappu's wife and his Brother-in-law tell Chandramukhi that Gappu's Mother-in-law is an excellent dancer. Gopi and Billu are shocked to see best friends Chappu and Gappu fighting near the market. Gappu and Chappu reveal a shocking truth to Chandramukhi. Chandramukhi, Bhola, Billu and Gopi come up with a master plan to find out the truth. Will they be successful?

videos.title: Jignes Tries to Commit Suicide
videos.overview: Chandramukhi as a newly married bride of Jignesh Patel arrives in the Patel Family to solve the case of Gappu and Chappu. She behaves exactly like Seedhi and does not allow Jignesh to live life on his own terms. Chandramukhi, Bhola, Gopi and Billu reveal a shocking truth to Jignesh and his Family. Will Seedhi apologize to Gappu?

videos.title: Chandramukhi Se Panga Mat Lena
videos.overview: Doctor Delhiwale files a fir against his Compounder who often locks him in the bathroom. The doctor also tells Chandramukhi that the Compounder is madly in love with a Pakodewali. Chandramukhi agrees with Pakodi and Babu and also gets angry with the Doctor for raising small issues. Doctor reveals to Billu and Gopi that Chandramukhi's life is in danger.

videos.title: Chautala's Childhood Secret
videos.overview: Billu and Gopi come up with an interesting plan to collect more information about Chandramukhi's childhood. She reveals one of her childhood secrets to Billu and Gopi. Billu and Gopi get to know about Chandramukhi's childhood friend Gunna. Will they go to find her?

videos.title: Chautala is Surprised to Meet Her Childhood Friend
videos.overview: Senior Inspector Bhola Pandit tries to cheer up Chandramukhi and also recites a beautiful poem for her. Chandramukhi is surprised to meet her childhood friend Gunna in Imaan Chowki. Chandramukhi gets angry with Gopi and Billu as they talk against Gunna. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Chedu Boss
videos.overview: A female employee Badi files a police complaint against her Boss who is teasing her. Chandramukhi gets angry with Badi's father who was stopping her from complaining to Chandramukhi about her Boss. Lawyer and Media arrive at  Imaan Chowki as she has arrested Badi's Boss. Gopi feels humiliated in Senior Inspector Bhola's cabin.

videos.title: Secretary Flirts With Bhola Pandit
videos.overview: Badi's Boss Prachin comes across yet another gorgeous employee who later becomes his Secretary. Chandramukhi as Prachin's Secretary tries to flirt with her Senior Inspector Bhola Pandit. Gopi reveals to Bhola that he is getting exploited in Imaan Chowki by his Senior Inspector. How will the case be solved?

videos.title: Acp Gopi Becomes a Constable
videos.overview: Constable Gopi of Imaan Chowki becomes ACP but this good news soon turns into the worst nightmare for Gopi as Commissioner reveals a shocking truth to Bhola, Gopi and Billu. Chandramukhi comes up with an interesting plan to fix cameras in the office. Will she succeed?

videos.title: Chautala Gets a Promotion
videos.overview: Billu and Gopi get a huge shock as they get to know about Chandramukhi's demotion letter. But she is excited and also clears the confusion by revealing that she has got a promotion. She teaches the Boss an unforgettable lesson.

videos.title: Car Meets an Accident
videos.overview: Chandramukhi is extremely happy about her promotion and also celebrates with her entire team. She is proud to have 3 stars on her uniform. Scooty's Father informs Chandramukhi about Scooty's Marriage. He tells Chandramukhi that he loves his car and also requests her to take extra care of the Car but a major trouble takes place as the car meets with an accident. How will Chautala deal with this?

videos.title: Billu and Gopi In Trouble
videos.overview: Gopi and Billu are trying their best to hide the car which got damaged. Billu and Gopi get nervous as Chandramukhi insists them to allow her to take a look at the car. They escape with the Car. Meanwhile, a couple comes to Imaan Chowki to file a police complaint against 2 thieves who stole their brand new car.

videos.title: Lehenga Tiwari Ke Anokhe Lehenge
videos.overview: Chandramukhi strictly warns Billu and Gopi not to commit any kind of mistake while decorating the car with flowers for her best friend's wedding. Bhola expresses his views on Lehenga Tiwari's lehenga. Chandramukhi buys a lehenga for the wedding after taking in advice from Bhola. Meanwhile, Gopi and Billu are hiding their faces so that they do not get caught for the stolen car.

videos.title: Car Ka Karnaama
videos.overview: Scooter Uncle's car is still missing, and Gopi and Billu are feeling riddled with guilt. The owner of the car visits the police station every day and is making them very nervous. Will they admit to their crime? Will they tell Chandramukhi or will she find out on her own? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Topi Pe Topi - Part 1
videos.overview: Gopi has found a new neighbour Mr Trilok and also introduces him to Billu. Gopi and Billu are surprised to see petrol underneath Trilok's ground and Trilok firmly decides to sell his house. Gopi also decides to sell his house and dreams to become a billionaire. Will Gopi succeed in his attempt?

videos.title: Topi Pe Topi - Part 2
videos.overview: Chandramukhi and her team are on the lookout for a gang of three men who have been evading the police for a very long time. Chandramukhi is concerned as so far, they have no lead on the gang, and is aggressively looking out to catch even one of them. Will she catch the culprits?

videos.title: Strict Mother
videos.overview: Billi introduces her college friend Gilehari who is actually Chandramukhi to her mother. Gopi is extremely upset as he sold his house to an unknown person. Billi's mother maintains strict discipline in the house and also forces her family members to maintain the discipline.

videos.title: Billi Goes Missing
videos.overview: Gileheri's father, a Brigadier, comes to meet Billi's mother. Gileheri arranges a poem recitation program in the house. In the meantime, Billi takes all the jewellery from the locker and runs. Later in the chowki, the mother comes to complain about Billi.  Chandramukhi comes to know who the thief is. Who is the thief?

videos.title: Phas Gaye Chandramukhi
videos.overview: Billu comes up with yet another plan to fool Gopi and he succeeds. A massive argument takes place between Chandramukhi and Senior Inspector Bhola Pandit. Mausa assumes Bhola Pandit as his Son-in-law. Bhola Pandit takes the help of his friend to get an actress to act as his girlfriend so that Mosaji will know about his character. Now Mosaji is firm about marrying Chandramukhi to Triloki Chaudhary after seeing Bhola Pandit. What happens next? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Bhola Pandit's New Girlfriend
videos.overview: Mosaji tells Chandramukhi that he has found out the truth about Senior Inspector Bhola Pandit and also warns her to stay away from him. Just when Chandramukhi was trying to defend Bhola, he arrives with his new girlfriend who works in Genda's Mehfil. Chandramukhi is shocked to see another girlfriend of Bhola. Mosaji swears that he will stay with Chandramukhi until she leaves Bhola Pandit.

videos.title: Bhola Pandit's Master Plan to Impress Mosa
videos.overview: Chandramukhi apologizes to Senior Inspector Bhola Pandit and Bhola assures her that he will solve her problem of marriage. Bhola Pandit tries to impress Mosaji but Mosaji has decided to engage Chandramukhi to Triloki. Billu teaches an unforgettable lesson to Triloki Chaudhary who has arrived in the chowki to marry Chandramukhi.

videos.title: Chautala and Trilokis Ring Ceremony
videos.overview: Mosaji and Triloki are eagerly waiting for Chandramukhi in the chowki. Billu, Gopi and Bhola come up with an interesting plan to trap Triloki Chaudhary who forcefully wants to marry Chandramukhi. Will Chandramukhi and Triloki exchange rings with each other?

videos.title: Chowki Mein Drama, Mach Gaya Hungama
videos.overview: Chandramukhi, Gopi and Billu have to perform in the play which will be conducted soon in the Chowki. A Boutique owner, Chappan Tiwali and a Beauty Parlor owner Manju file a police complaint against each other. Gopi assures Chandramukhi that his friend Amit Aryan is a writer and he will definitely write a play for them. But when he goes to meet him Amit Aryan insults him and throws him out of the house. Who will write the script now?

videos.title: Billu and Gopi Find a Brilliant Writer
videos.overview: F.I.R. is a situational comedy serial centered on a Haryanvi female police officer named Chandramukhi Chautala and her three subordinates. The show depicts their lives as they try to solve every case which comes to Imman Chowki, Ravanpur. New cases come to the police station in every episode. An individual or a group come with a complaint or a problem. It may be a case of love, divorce, snoring, or bad cooking. Chandramukhi Chautala and her constables solve the case successfully though the case has nothing to do with their official duties as police officer.

videos.title: Gopi Reveals The Truth to Bhola
videos.overview: Senior inspector Bhola Pandit gets to know about Gopi's master plan and also gets angry with them. The writer reveals the truth to Bhola about Chautals's debut as a novelist. Gopi only has 2 days to stay with his loving team. Now Chandramukhi has completed his wish and he has to die. Will Gopi die?

videos.title: Chowki Mein Rinkunath
videos.overview: Billu, Gopi and Gulgule would have almost got suspended if Chandramukhi's favourite cricketer Harsh Rinkunath wouldn't have been playing the match. Gulgule comes up with an interesting plan to impress Chandramukhi and also informs her about his arrival in the chowki. How will Chandramukhi react?

videos.title: Gulgule's Master Plan
videos.overview: Gulgule asks the pan shop owner to mimic Cricketer Harsh Rinkunath and talk to Chandramukhi to give him half-day holiday. Chandramukhi talks to him on the phone and agrees to give Gulgule half-day holiday. The news comes out that real Cricketer Harsh Rinkunath is coming to Rawanpur and Chandramukhi is suppose to go and receive him. Will Chandramukhi find out the truth?

videos.title: Gulgule Gets Final Warning
videos.overview: Cricketer Harsh Rinkunath has arrived in Rawanpur.  Chandramukhi insists to meet him. She asks Gulgule to get him to the chowki on any condition. Billu and Gopi also insist.  Gulgule somehow asks Cricketer Harsh Rinkunath to come to the chowki. He goes and tell Chandramukhi that Cricketer Harsh Rinkunath will be coming to the chowki.

videos.title: Rinkunath Arrives In Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Cricketer Harsh Rinkunath comes to the chowki after Gulgule tells Chandramukhi the truth. Billu plays a prank on Gopi by making him believe that the lady entering in the chowki is in love with him. He tries to flirt with her. She turns out to be a social worker Gulli Galauti. She has to come to filr am FIR against a man who was troubling a woman. Will Chandramukhi find out about Billu's prank?

videos.title: Mazak Mazak
videos.overview: Chandramukhi and Gopi hire a girl to play a part in the prank which they decide to play on Billu. Gopi as Chhedilal asks Billu to marry his daughter Mamta. Billu takes her on a date and she acts as a haunted girl. Billu is terrified and later comes to know that Gopi played a prank on him.  Chandramukhi warns Billu and Gopi to be serious at work. They start acting serious and responsible. But till when can they act serious?

videos.title: Inspector Patel's New Problem
videos.overview: Billu, Gopi and Chandramukhi have firmly decided to be very serious and strict in the chowki. There is a sudden change in everybody's behavior. Inspector Patel files a police complaint against his friend. A couple files a police complaint against Constable Gopi. What has Gopi done now?

videos.title: Billu and Gopi's New Business
videos.overview: The owner of Duggal Dhaba tells Gopi that he is not at all happy with Chandramukhi's orders of shutting the restaurants after 11 p.m. Billu finds a brilliant opportunity and also convinces Gopi to support him in converting the chowki into a restaurant in the absence of CC. Will Gopi give in to Billu?

videos.title: Billu and Gopi's Restaurant
videos.overview: Billu and Gopi get caught by Chandramukhi and Gulgule. Billu and Gopi are assuming that she is still not aware of their new restaurant. Billu's memory loss problem is becoming a huge pain for Duggal. Chandramukhi decides to teach him a lesson. How will she?

videos.title: Restaurant Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: According to Chandramukhi's plan Gulgule eats at the restaurant and pretends to be dead. Billu hides the dead body behind an old cupboard. Chandramukhi tries to sell the cupboard but Billu and Gopi do not allow her. Later the dead body disappears fron the cupboard. Gulgule calls Chandramukhi from the hiding place and tells her that their plan is being successful. Will the two constables learn a lesson?

videos.title: Aala Re Aala Mika Aala
videos.overview: Gopi lands in deep trouble as he had assured one of his colleagues Chandu that he will get famous playback singer Mika Singh at Chandu's Brother-in-law's wedding to perform. Gopi gets to know that Mika Singh is arriving in Raawanpur. Item and Director Patel shares their project with Chandramukhi. Will Gopi succeed in his mission?

videos.title: Mika Singh Arrives In Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: One of finest of the Playback Singers of the Indian Film Industry, Mika Singh arrives in Raawanpur at Imaan Chowki to meet Chandramukhi. Gopi and Billu are surprised to see him. Local Manager of Mika identifies Gopi and Billu who threw stones at Mika's Car. Watch Mika Singh and Chandramukhi's mission to teach a lesson to Dabbu Dabang

videos.title: Chautala and Mika's Electrifying Dance Performance
videos.overview: Gopi and Billu come up with an evil plan to kidnap famous Playback Singer Mika Singh, the moment he arrives in Imaan Chowki but they miserably fail and get caught. Chandramukhi and Mika Singh have a dance performance. Watch this episode to know more.

videos.title: Gopi Ko Nazar Aaye Din Mein Taare
videos.overview: There seems to be a problem in Gopi's eyesight. Billu and Gopi meet with an accident. Gopi firmly decides not to share his eye problem with Chandramukhi and also insists Billu to hide the secret. What will happen when Chandramukhi will come to know about Gopi's eye problem? Will Gopi get suspended?

videos.title: Gopi's Job is In Danger
videos.overview: Senior Inspector is down at Imaan Chowki, to evaluate Chandramukhi's workforce and senses something wrong with Gopi's eyesight. If he finds out that Gopi is not able to see properly, he could lose his job. Chandramukhi then devises an ingenious plan to ensure that he is able to spot a tiny strand of hair in his presence.

videos.title: Gopi's Shooting Test
videos.overview: Senior Inspector Manhar has arrived in Imaan Chowki to test Gopi's shooting skills and also insists him to shoot at lemons placed on each Constable's Head. Will Gopi successfully pass the test? Will Constables survive? To know Chandramukhi's next plan to save Gopi's job, watch this hilarious episode of F.I.R.

videos.title: Lipstick Man
videos.overview: Auto Driver Sushil Punjabi files a police complaint against an unknown person who applied lipstick while he was sleeping in his auto. Gopi recollects one of the incidents that took place with him in the Village. The owner of Paris Beauty Parlor, Sharmilamalini reveals the truth to Chandramukhi. She is shocked to see another Auto Driver Bhaloo with the same problem that Sushil had. How will the case be solved?

videos.title: Lipstick Man Targets Gopi
videos.overview: One of the workers of Circus rushes to Imaan Chowki to file a missing complaint of a Make-up artist Kulbhushan. Gopi feels humiliated as he also became one of the targets of Lipstick Man. Chandramukhi and Gopi are shocked to see the CCTV footage. Chandramukhi observes a Monkey applying Lipstick to Gopi. Will her master plan work?

videos.title: Monkey Man Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Chandramukhi reveals her master plan to Gulgule, Gopi and Billu as she wants to nab the Monkey who is spreading fear in Raawanpur by applying Lipstick. Chandramukhi chases the Monkey and successfully manages to arrest her. To find out more, watch this hilarious episode of F.I.R.

videos.title: Chandramukhi Ki Holi - Part 1
videos.overview: Chandramukhi is in an extremely bad mood as Gopi & Billu are late for work again. When Gopi arrives, he begs Chandramukhi to write his FIR against someone who assaulted him. When she refuses to write his complaint, Gopi vows to never bully those who come in to write their FIR again. Will he stay true to his vow? Watch this episode to find out

videos.title: Chandramukhi Ki Holi - Part 2
videos.overview: Gopi suffers from severe pain as Billu unknowingly applies a unique paste on Gopi's face. Chandramukhi comes up with an interesting plan to save Gopi's job. IG falls in love with a Female Constable. Chandramukhi questions IG about his past affair and IG shares his painful love story. What will happen when IG will come to know the truth about the Female Constable in Imaan Chowki? Who is she? To find out, watch this special hilarious episode of Chandramukhi Ki Holi.

videos.title: Modak Ka Rahasya
videos.overview: 200 years old ancient Golden Modak gets stolen from Lord Ganesha's Temple. Sarpanch of the Village files a police complaint against the thief. Chandramukhi, Billu and Gopi urgently leave for the Village where the temple is located. Chandramukhi searches for Gopi in the Jungle. Gopi gets robbed. Will Chandramukhi find out the secret about the Golden Modak?

videos.title: Chautala Interrogates Pujariji

An individual or a group come with a complaint or a problem. It may be a case of love, divorce, snoring, or bad cooking. Chandramukhi Chautala and her constables solve the case successfully though the case has nothing to do with their official duties as police officer.

videos.title: Chautala's Master Plan to Arrest Modak Thief
videos.overview: Billu and Gopi are enjoying the atmosphere of the village but this apparently does not go down well with Chandramukhi. Gopi once again comes across the Lavani Girl and gets scared. Chandramukhi reveals her master plan to nab the thief. Has Chandramukhi caught her? Who is she?

videos.title: The Modak Mystery Continues
videos.overview: Gotya and his family wait outside the temple waiting for the gates to open for his wedding, but soon discover that his bride has been married off to someone else. Just then, Chandramukhi arrives disguised as a foreign tourist. Will she discover who the real 'Modak Thief' is, in this disguise?

videos.title: Gangubai
videos.overview: Mukesh Mehta and his wife Lalita file a police complaint against a thief who robbed valuable belongings from their house. Couple is surprised to see Gangubai in Imaan Chowki. Billu and Gopi are shocked to see Gangubai who looks similar to Chandramukhi. What is the secret of Gangubai? Watch this hilarious episode to find out.

videos.title: Commissioner Gets Robbed By Gangubai
videos.overview: Chandramukhi gets a huge shock as Commissioner reveals to her that Gangubai robbed him. Chandramukhi observes Gangubai's footage and gets surprised to see her looks. Star cast of Youngistaan, Actor Jackky Bhagnani and Actress Neha Sharma arrive in Imaan Chowki to explain the importance of vote. Will Gangubai get arrested? To know more, watch this hilarious episode of F.I.R.

videos.title: Chautala Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Gangubai is spreading fear of robbery in Rawanpur. Chandramukhi becomes Gangubai to arrest Gangubai and prove her innocence but a major problem arises as she gets arrested by Billu and Gopi in Imaan Chowki. Chandramukhi is in jail. How will Chandramukhi prove to Commissioner that she is not involved in stealing valuable belongings from people?

videos.title: Highway Ka Rahasya
videos.overview: After Gangubai, Chandramukhi comes across yet another case of the secret of highway. A couple from Attara files a police complaint against a landlord who doesn't allow them to fill the water from the well. Instead of Highway, Gopi arrives in a Garden. Where has Gopi landed? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Gangubai Visits Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Chandramukhi walks into Imaan Chowki, dressed as Gangubai, but Billu and Gopi fail to recognize her. She gives them an earful for their negligence and tells them about her new plan to catch this cunning lady-thief. Will she succeed?

videos.title: Rajkumari Kamalchakshuni In Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Billu and Gopi are shocked to see Chandramukhi as Rajkumari Kamalchakshuni and also assume that she is on a mission to crack the highway case. A group of Theatre artists performing Mythological plays reveals a shocking truth to Chandramukhi. What is the secret of Highway?

videos.title: Chandramukhi Ka Mahila Suraksha Abhiyaan
videos.overview: A College Student named Meera, studying in Allahabad University files an eve teasing complaint against 2 Boys Prem and Chappu Chopra who not only follow Meera but also tease her in the bus that she travels. Chautala takes strict actions against Prem and Chappu. To know Chautala's next move, watch this hilarious episode

videos.title: Prem and Chappu Get Arrested
videos.overview: Chautala gives a unique solution to Meera to get Prem and Chappu out of her way but instead of Prem and Chappu, Gopi and Billu land in deep trouble. Prem and Chappu Chopra get arrested but Chautala still has a doubt on Chaturvedi. How will Chautala solve Meera's never ending problem? Watch this episode to find out!

videos.title: Chautala Urgently Calls For a Press Conference
videos.overview: Commissioner tells Chautala to urgently leave Prem and Chopra as they have high connections with ministers. Chautala firmly decides to teach an unforgettable lesson to Chaturvedi so she calls a press conference. What happened in the press conference? Watch this hilarious episode.

videos.title: Chandramukhi Bani Chitrakar
videos.overview: Chandramukhi meets an old friend, a banker, who pursues dancing in her free time. She encourages Chandramukhi too to pursue her childhood hobby of painting. Her colleagues however are a little concerned about her new passion. Watch this hilarious episode to find out why.

videos.title: Chandramukhi's Unbelievable Painting
videos.overview: Chandramukhi Chautala has become an Artist and is also working hard towards the same in Imaan Chowki. Chautala fumes in anger as Gopi and Billu get highly impressed by Chautala's unbelievable painting. Chautala is expecting a Guest in Imaan Chowki. Who is he? Watch to find out!

videos.title: 2 Francis In Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Painter Chandramukhi is surprised to see 2 Painting Teachers Mr. Francis in Imaan Chowki. Billu falls in love with Mr. Francis's Daughter. Chautala comes up with her unique plan to find out who the real Mr. Francis is. Will Chautala succeed? Who is Mr. Francis? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Chunav Chunav
videos.overview: Bantu Tandon files a police complaint against 2 Boys who work with a local politician. Bantu reveals to Chautala that he spoke the truth about the politician and they have warned him that he will not be able to marry. Chautala continues to teach lessons to Women on self-defence. How will Chautala save Bantu Tandon? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Bajrang Pandey Returns
videos.overview: Not only Gopi and Billu but Chautala is also extremely excited to meet their Senior Inspector Bajarang Pandey. Chautala gets a huge shock as she observes a woman named Jaanu who was accompanying Pandeyji. Gopi and Billu welcome Pandeyji in Imaan Chowki but even they are shocked to see Jaanu. Is Pandeyji married to Jaanu? Will Gopi and Billu find out the truth?

videos.title: Bajrang Ne Mari Entriyaan
videos.overview: Chautala seems sulky upon meeting Bajrang Pandey as she has learnt that he is now married. Bajrang however, doesn't seem to understand why she gave him such a cold welcome. Is he really married? Watch this episode to find out

videos.title: Shaadi Tut Gayi
videos.overview: While Chandramukhi is teaching self defence to women, a father and daughter come to the chowki to file a complain that whenever she is about to get married, someone puts in a small chit that questions her character and hence, she is not able to get married. How will Chautala solve this?

videos.title: Marriage Proposal For Manjri
videos.overview: To find out who is becoming a barrier for Manjri in her marriage, Billu, Gopi, Chautala and Bajrang Pandey come up with an interesting plan to nab the person who doesn't want Manjri to get married. Will Chautala's master plan work? Who is he? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Chandu Reveals a Shocking Truth to Chautala
videos.overview: Chautala urgently calls Manjri's family members to Imaan Chowki and also insists all of them to remove their shoes. Chautala and Senior Inspector Bajrang Pandey find the unknown person. Who is he? Why does he not want Manjri to settle down? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Jhangia Baniyaan Gang
videos.overview: AC Nigam and Kamla Nigam residing in Janta Nagar, Raawanpur files a police complanit against Jhangia Baniyaan Gang as a robbery occurs in their house. Another Woman also comes up with the same issue. How will Chautala arrest the gang? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Bajrang Struggles to Get a Train Reservation
videos.overview: Bajrang Pandey is extremely upset that he is unable to make a train reservation for his mother. Meanwhile a new criminal, 'Jangiya Banyan' is wreaking havoc in town. How will Chandramukhi solve the case while Bajrang tries to make a train reservation?

videos.title: Gopi's Encounter With Hunter
videos.overview: Public takes the initiative to nab Jhangia Baniyaan Gang and they succeed too but unfortunately Gopi gets caught. Gopi plans to take a leave for a day. Will Chautala approve his leave? Will they succeed in nabbing Jhangia Baniyaan Gang? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Yeh Flat Kab Banega
videos.overview: Sumo is helping out Chautala in finding the missing link of Jhangiya Baniyan Gang. One of the members of Jhangiya Baniyan Gang gets arrested and thus Chautala finds the entire group. A Couple gets caught by Gopi in a Police Jeep. Mr & Mrs. Teda share their flat problem with Chautala. Who is Chandan? Will Chautala solve their flat issue? Watch this hilarious episode to find out!

videos.title: Builder Patel and Patwardhan Fight In Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Mr and Mrs. Tedha are staying in Imaan Chowki since they don't have a house as their builder has defaulted on the deadline. Mr. Tedha's Father arrives in Imaan Chowki to meet their Children. Builder Patel and his Business Partner Patwardhan fight in Imaan Chowki. Chautala gets angry with them. Will Senior Inspector Pandeyji express his feelings for Chautala?

videos.title: Patwardhan and Patel's Master Plan
videos.overview: Gopi takes Patwardhan and Builder Patel to a restaurant to solve their problem but Gopi, Chautalala, Gulgule and Billu are not aware of Patwardhan and Builder Patel's master plan. Chautala doubts on both of them. Senior Inspector Bajrang comes up with an interesting plan. Will they succeed in finding the truth?

videos.title: Chit Chor
videos.overview: Chautala teaches an unforgettable lesson to Builder Patel and Mr. Patwardhan in Imaan Chowki as she helps them in cracking a huge deal by introducing them to one of her client. Mr and Mrs. Tedha are excited to shift to their new house. There comes another case for Chautala. A robbery occurs in Aashiq's House and thief leaves a message too.

videos.title: Chit Chor Investigation Continues
videos.overview: A man files an FIR stating that someone has been harassing him by leaving 'chits' at his doorstep everyday. Chautala has his neighbour questioned for this but finds that she too is being harassed by the same person. Who could this sadistic criminal be?

videos.title: Gopi and Billu's Master Plan to Nab Chit Chor
videos.overview: Chautala comments on Billu and Gopi's brilliant idea of nabbing Chit Chor who is stealing valuable belongings from innocent people's houses. Chuatala and Bajrang as Rampyaari Dhoban and Rampyaare Dhobi arrive in the building. Will Chautala and Bajrang's plan work?

videos.title: Bahadur Reveals a Shocking Truth to Chautala
videos.overview: Chautala comes up with an interesting plan to nab the thief (Chit Chor) of the building as he steals valuable belongings from that particular building. Bahadur of the building reveals a shocking truth to Chautala.

videos.title: Chandramukhi Online
videos.overview: Chautala's 3 biggest fans arrive in Imaan Chowki with Red Roses to prove their love for Chautala. Chautala sends a message daily on her official police page. Senior Inspector Bajrang's mother has arrived in the city to meet Chautala. Will Chautala find out the truth?

videos.title: Chautala's Online Account Gets Hacked
videos.overview: Chautala once again gets angry with her crazy fans as they are ready to fulfil all her wishes in Imaan Chowki. Chautala is shocked to see her look alike in online. Senior Inspector Bajrang is upset with Chautala. Who has hacked Chautala's account?

videos.title: Chautala's Suspension Orders
videos.overview: The Commissioner reveals to Chautala that she will soon get suspended from the post of Inspector and from Imaan Chowki as well. Chautala asks for 24 hours to prove that she is innocent and also finds an important clue in the graveyard.

videos.title: Birthday Mein Baj Gaya Band
videos.overview: Mr. Chaman walks into Imaan chowki to file an FIR against 3 of his friends because of whom he doesn't want to celebrate his birthday. The reason being that the birthday bumps they give him later leave him with a severe back injury.

videos.title: Aaj Chutti Hai
videos.overview: On Labour Day, all the constables of Imaan Chowki firmly decide not work and serve the country. However, this apparently does not go down too well with Senior Inspector Bajrang and Chautala. Gopi and Billu refuse to work on Labour Day. How will Chautala make Billu and Gopi work? Will Bajrang come up with an interesting plan?

videos.title: Bas Main Ho Gaya Bebas
videos.overview: A Maths Professor files a police complaint against a Bus Conductor for not giving him a change despite having it with him. Chautala gets angry with the Bus Conductor. However the bus conductor reveals a shocking truth to Chautala in his defence. How will Chautala solve the case of Bus Conductor and Professor? Who is Sana?

videos.title: Hum Achhe Padosi Hai
videos.overview: Patti files a Police complaint against his neighbour Behra in Imaan Chowki. Chautala and Senior Inspector Bajrang pose as Mr and Mrs. Robert and try to solve Patti's problem. What will happen to Mr. Behra?

videos.title: Phone Message Phone
videos.overview: Paro Mehta files a police complaint against her husband who is ignoring her and giving more importance to his cell phone. Businessman Chaman Mehta arrives in Imaan Chowki. Chautala teaches an unforgettable lesson to Mr. Mehta. Meanwhile, will Bajrang ever be able express his feelings to Chautala?

videos.title: Chunnu Chaatwala
videos.overview: Gappu and Chappu rush to Imaan Chowki to file a police complaint against Chunnu Chaatwala. Ms. Gappu and Ms. Chappu who love to eat chaat are asked to meet Chautala urgently. How will Chautala solve the case of Chunnu Chaatwala?

videos.title: Jewellery Lut Gayee
videos.overview: A jeweller Kapadia and his manager Dimple come into the police station to complain of a necklace worth Rs.20 Lakhs being stolen from their shop. They even claim to have a CCTV recording of the burglary. Will Chautala help them find the criminals?

videos.title: Mahila Police
videos.overview: Famous Heroine Chandani Chauhan's Sister Sunita Chauhan requests Chautala to help her in finding Chandani's personal diary in which all her personal details were written in great details. Chandani's hair dresser Heena arrives in Imaan Chowki. What will be Chautala's plan to find Chandani's personal diary?

videos.title: New Mahila Police In Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: A new Police Inspector Pinky Tiwari closely working with Chautala in Imaan Chowki on Chandani's case. Gopi and Billu are suspended from Imaan Chowki. Chautala questions heroine Chandani's make-up artist Julie about the personal diary. Will Chautala and Pinky's plan work?

videos.title: Driver and Sunita Get Arrested
videos.overview: Chautala and Pinky go on the sets pretending to be reporters. They offer Julie and Chipakpal twenty lakh rupees for juicy gossip with proof in return. Someone calls Chautala for the money in exchange of money. Pinky sees Chipakpal and Julie exchanging bags. They are brought to chowky. Here Chautala reveals that culprit is none other than Chandani's sister Sunita and her boyfriend Chipakpal. They are arrested.

videos.title: Kishore Kumar Paan Khilayega
videos.overview: Mrs.Puglet lodges an FIR against her husband for visiting a night club. Mr.Puglet explains that he was attacked by a person wearing singer Kishore Kumar's mask and forcefully feeding him paan. Chautala does not believe him, warns him and send him home. Later that night, Gopi is attacked in same way. Chautala comes to know about the paan shop named Kishore pan shop.She starts her investigations in full earnest.

videos.title: Mujhe Arrest Karlo
videos.overview: Atta tries to get arrested couple of times and Chautala keeps on warning him and leaves him. Finally fed up she asks him about his problem. He tells her that he is trying to save himself from his wife and mother-in-law who keeps on making him work all day when they party.Chautala decides to teach them a lesson.

videos.title: Napoleon Ka Dastana
videos.overview: A historian reveals to Chautala that the golden gloves belong to the King of France, Napoleon Bonaparte. Chautala tries to get in touch with the one of the members of the Museum located in France. How will Chautala solve the mysterious case of Napoleon's antique Gloves?

videos.title: Secret Of Napoleon's Daughter
videos.overview: Chautala is hell bent on getting to the bottom of things and learn the truth. Chautala firmly decides to crack the code of Napoleon's Golden gloves and also decides to visit France. Who is Emily? What is the secret of Napoleon's daughter?

videos.title: Napoleon Ki Beti
videos.overview: A strange man walks into the chowki one day & tells Chautala that she may be the reincarnation of Napoleon's daughter. Chauatala refuses to believe it at first but also promises to keep this a secret upon the man's request. Gopi & Billu start to sense that she is probably hiding something.

videos.title: Bijli Ka Bill
videos.overview: Everyone is gathered around Inspector Chautala and are shocked with the electricity bill that has been on the rise for no apparent reason. A teacher, Chaukan Ojha, arrives at the station with a similar issue that the inspector is facing at the station. He claims that all he has at home is a table fan and a bulb. They figure out that Pappu Power is the company that provides power to their homes. The owner of the company is summoned for questioning.

videos.title: Bijli Bill Fraud
videos.overview: The cops at Imaan Chowki are flabbergasted by their electricity bill for the month. They are shocked as they have done nothing that could have caused such a huge increase in the bill! Is there foul play at work? Watch this hilarious episode to find out!

videos.title: Do Dilon Ke Khel Mein
videos.overview: Chautala gets angry with Gopi and Billu as they are not proving to be of a great help to Chautala in Imaan Chowki. Chef Navin Khanna files a police complaint against his neighbour Chandani who is insisting him to cook delicious items. Has Billu found his new love?

videos.title: Dabbawala Rejects Billu's Marriage Proposal
videos.overview: Billu is extremely happy and over-excited as he has finally found his true love in the dabbawala's daughter Chandani. Dabbawala rejects Billu's marriage proposal but this apparently does not go down too well with Chautala and Bajrang. Will Chautala and Bajrang's master plan work?

videos.title: Billu's Sacrifice
videos.overview: Chautala is shocked as constable Billu insults Dabbawala in Imaan Chowki. Chautala praises Billu as she gets to know about Billu's grand sacrifice. A strange case of Lift comes across Chautala. Ghanshyam Ghamandi and Ghanghor Ghamandi living in Mohabbat Appartment file a police complaint against an unknown person who writes shocking messages inside the lift.

videos.title: The Lift
videos.overview: Ghanshyam Ghamandi and Ghanghor Ghamandi living in Mohabbat Apartment file a Police complaint against an unknown person who writes shocking messages inside the lift. Ghanshyam expresses his doubts on Ex-Secretary Mr. Chaturbhuj. Who wrote message in the lift? Who is revealing the truth about Mr and Mrs. Ghamnadi in the lift?

videos.title: Roothna Manana
videos.overview: Pandey tries to woo Chautala, she is unsure of how to respond to his affection. When she finds out that roothna-manana is a way of courtship, she decides to try it out on Pandey. Is it going to work or is it going to backfire on her?

videos.title: Band Baja
videos.overview: Chandramukhi Chautala comes across a strange case in Imaan Chowki. A Bride's Father files a police complaint against the Groom on the wedding day as they missed the scheduled Mahurat of marriage. Chautala gets angry with the band members. Will band members reveal the truth to Chautala?

videos.title: Search For Dulhan Tunni
videos.overview: Chautala, Gopi and Billu are in search of Dulhan Tunni and also interrogate the band members. Gopi and Billu get badly beaten up. Chautala teaches an unforgettable lesson to band members. Who is Tunni? Will Tunni reveal the truth to Chautala? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Secret Of Dulhan
videos.overview: Chautala and Bajrang make sure that there is no interruption in the wedding and also come up with an interesting plan to find out the secret of the dulhan. Constable Golu requests Chautala to forgive Dulhan. What will be Chautala's final decision? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Chandramukhi Ka Hungama
videos.overview: Chautala fumes in anger as Traffic Police Pinky Tiwari apologizes to Jhunnu, Babloo and Bunty. Chautala gets to know about Jhunnu's rash driving. Jhunnu and his gang arrive in Imaan Chowki but Chautala fails to arrest them. How will Chautala teach a lesson to Jhunnu and his gang? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Gopi and Billu Get Caught By a Traffic Police
videos.overview: Constable Gopi and Billu get caught by Honest Traffic Police Pinky Tiwari for breaking the signal. Babloo and Bunty get badly beaten up by Chautala. How will Chautala teach a lesson to Jhunnu? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Hamirpur Express
videos.overview: Chandramukhi Chautala teaches Jhunnu a very unforgettable lesson with the help of Bajrang Pandey, Gopi and Billu. Chautala comes across yet another strange case of Hamirpur Express. A scientist files a police complaint against a thief who has stolen his chemical. Scientist reveals to Chautala that his chemical should not get injected in Human's body.

videos.title: Chemical Thief's Escape Plan
videos.overview: The scientist reveals to Chautala that the chemical thief is planning to escape from Rawanpur Junction. The scientist and Chautala rush to the railway station to find out in which train the chemical thief is travelling. Will Bajrang become chemical thief's next target?

videos.title: Vitamin D
videos.overview: The scientist comes up with an interesting solution to solve the itching problem of all those passengers who are travelling in Hamirpur Express. Chautala manages to get inside the running train. Bajrang is shocked to see Chautala's medical reports. Is the doctor hiding something from Chautala?

videos.title: Chautala's Classical Attempt
videos.overview: Billu, Gopi and Bajrang reveal a shocking truth about Chautala's classical performance. Musician Panchhi files FIR against Ruchi for selling him a sitar in the name of tabla. But even in front of Chautala, Ruchi is not ready to accept that it is sitar and not tabla. Bajrang takes extra care of Chautala as she seems to be unwell.

videos.title: Chautala Forgets Her Identity
videos.overview: Guttan Uncle and Baby Chautala - Jwalamukhi Chautala pretends to have forgtten who she is and acts out different personalities like a baby or an exotic dancer in front of the IGP. Why is she doig this? Who is she after?

videos.title: Chatri Chor
videos.overview: Gappu Gaviya files a police complaint against an Umbrella Thief as his mother-in-law's prestigious umbrella gets stolen. Who is stealing innocent people's umbrella and why?

videos.title: Chimpu Man In Rawanpur
videos.overview: The case of Chatri Chor continues and Chautala comes across a sketch of Chimpu Man so she urgently calls the cartoonist who has designed Chimpu Man. Chautala doubts on the contractor who is repairing Imaan Chowki's roof. How will Chautala find out the truth about Chimpu Man?

videos.title: Diamond Trader Jamnadas is Missing
videos.overview: Chautala warns contractor Mishra to wind up Imaan Chowki's work within 24 hours. Chautala recollects a 20 year old case of a diamond trader Jamnadas who is missing and so are  his diamonds. Chautala has a plan to crack the code of Chatri Chor.

videos.title: Chautala Gets to Know About Chatri Lover
videos.overview: Chautala gets to know about a mental patient who is in search of an Umbrella. Chautala has almost cracked the code of Umbrella's broken handles. Why is this mental patient stealing umbrellas of innocent people and breaking handles?

videos.title: New Female Constable In Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Billu is surprised to see a new Female Constable Meena Ganpat Rao Godbole in Imaan Chowki. Senior Inspector Bajrang Pandey firmly decides to express his feelings to Chautala. Will Bajrang propose to Chautala?

videos.title: Chandramukhi Chali Nepal
videos.overview: Commissioner's school friend Seth shares his problem with Chautala in Imaan Chowki and also requests her to bring her daughter back to Chitputiya Ganj from Kathmandu for marriage. Will Chautala succeed in finding Seth's Daughter?

videos.title: Secret Of Koma Thapa
videos.overview: A Boy and a Girl are keeping an eye on Chautala in Imaan Chowki and also inform their Boss in Nepal about Koma Thapa. Sr. Inspector Bajrang is eagerly waiting for the 5th day as he has to say those three magical words to Chautala. Who is Koma Thapa? Whats is the secret of Koma Thapa?

videos.title: Bhanu Mishra's Master Plan
videos.overview: Bhanu Mishra and her partner come up with an interesting plan to find out the truth about Chautala and Koma Thapa. Gopi and Billu are shocked to see a female vegetable seller in the Market. Will Chautala come to know about Koma Thapa?

videos.title: Koma Thapa Gets Kidnapped
videos.overview: Chautala gets kidnapped from the Hospital by Bhanu Mishra and her partner. Chautala reaches Nepal and also gets to know the secret about dairy and Koma Thapa. What is the secret hidden in the dairy?

videos.title: Daily Soap
videos.overview: Producer and Director of a popular daily soap serial file a missing complaint of their two heroines who have mysteriously gone missing. Chautala decides to find out the truth. To know Chautala, Billu, Bajrang and Gopi's master plan?.

videos.title: Chautala's Unforgettable Daily Soap Scene
videos.overview: Chautala has become a lead star of a popular daily soap serial and also mesmerizes the crew and her co-actors with her stunning performance. Director and Producer rush to Imaan Chowki to file a missing complaint of yet another member from their team. Who is she? Will Chautala find out the truth?

videos.title: Chautala Doubts On Daily Soap's Hero
videos.overview: Chautala comes up with an interesting plan and casts Billu as a woman in her ongoing serial. Chautala expresses her doubt on the lady who is playing the role of mother-in-law and on the hero of the serial as well. How come members of the crew are going missing?

videos.title: Mother In Law Vanishes From The Set
videos.overview: Chautala is shocked as she gets to know about the third person vanishing from the set of a daily soap serial. Chautala expresses her doubt on the cameraman. Is he involved in daily soap case? To know more about Chautala's strategy, watch this hilarious episode.

videos.title: New Hero In Daily Soap
videos.overview: After two people missing from daily soap set, Producer and Director reveal to Chautala in Imaan Chowki that now their Hero is also missing. Chautala gets to know a shocking truth about the Hero. Daily Soap people have found a new Hero. Will Bajrang be able to express his feelings

videos.title: Gopi and Chautala Get Kidnapped
videos.overview: Instead of Chautala, Gopi gets kidnapped from Daily Soap set. A frustrated Bengali Director is torturing all those people who have vanished from the set and is forcing them to obey his orders. Chautala too gets kidnapped. How will Chautala solve the case of Daily soap serial?

videos.title: Jhapad Yoga
videos.overview: Kaushalya from Kanpur reveals to Chautala that she is having a doubt on her husband Mr. Singada of having an affair. Chautala gets to know about a Baba and his unique exercise Jhapad Yoga. To know more about Chautala's master plan and Jhapad Yoga., watch this highly amusing episode of F.I.R.

videos.title: Peru Kho Gaya
videos.overview: Musibat Mishra and her Husband lodge a police complaint against their neighbour Premika who not only calls Mr. Mishra a dog but also treats him like a dog in the society. Shayar Premika reveals the truth about Peru. Where is Peru? Who is Peru?

videos.title: Chautala, Gopi and Billu's Unique Case
videos.overview: For the first time ever in the history of F.I.R., Chautala, Gopi, Billu and Bajrang solve the case in front of an audience. A Couple files a Police complaint against a Doctor who forgot to remove the cell phone from his stomach. Chautala comes up with an interesting plan of Preeto in Imaan Chowki.

videos.title: Bajrang's Code Word
videos.overview: Mulayam Singh Gulgule who has created a record of getting slapped by Chautala returns to Imaan Chowki. Members present in Imaan Chowki get scared as Senior Inspector Bajrang reveals his new code word. A Bride and Groom's Family arrive in police station with their unique problem. Chautala conducts marriage in Imaan Chowki. Will Billu find his Bride?

videos.title: Billu Becomes Doctor
videos.overview: Billu has fallen in love with a doctor's daughter and has told her that he is a doctor too. He convinces Chautala to transform Imaan Chowki into a Nursing Home. But when Daughter and he father come, Billu's plan doesn't work. Later a couple comes to chowky with a complaint against a thug Tutu Tamaatar who  teases women in their area. She gets the thug to the chowky and challenges him with an arm fight. She wins and puts Tutu Tamaatar in jail.

videos.title: Shayar-e-mehfil In Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Chautala's best friend reveals to her that it is becoming extremely difficult to convince her boyfriend Geet's family for marriage. She helps her with her marriage problem. Later, a couple lodges a complaint against a travel agency. They had asked travel agent to book for 5 days stay in hotel and they booked for day time only and he and his wife had to sleep on the road during the night. Chautala helps him get a compensation trip from the Agency and the case is solved.

videos.title: Likhit Lakhotiya's Bhadku Tonic
videos.overview: Likhit's wife rushes to Chowky to file a police complaint against her Husband as she observes a sudden change in her husband's behaviour. Likhit Lakhotiya reveals to Chautala about Hakim Saab's Bhadku Tonic. To know more about Chautala's unique plan, watch this hilarious episode.

videos.title: Shocking Shock to Gopi
videos.overview: Gopi gets a huge shock after listening something on the phone call. Chautala, Billu and Gulgule are shocked to see Gopi in this state. What has happened to Gopi? What did he hear on the phone call? Watch out for more. Don't miss your favourite hilarious show.

videos.title: Kissa Tabeez Ka
videos.overview: Gopi and billu find a way to reduce Chautala's anger. They meet a baba who claims that if Gopi and Billu buy a locket from him and wear, she will never get angry at them. Gopi and Billu buy the locket and to their surprise every time she is about to get angry they show the locket and she gets pacified.What is the secret of the locket?

videos.title: Dulhaniya Ki Problem
videos.overview: A man comes and complains about his wife Dulhania who never smiles and neither allows him to smile because of which his life has become hell. Now Chautala and her whole team come together to find a unique solution to solve Dulhaniya's case.

videos.title: Chautala Ka Beta
videos.overview: Senior Inspector Bajrang Pandey is extremely happy as he has successfully managed to make a fool of Gopi and Billu but this apparently does not go down too well with Chautala and she comes up with an interesting plan to teach a lesson to Bajrang. Gopi, Billu and Bajrang are shocked to meet Chautala's son.

videos.title: Gopi Celebrates Raksha Bandhan
videos.overview: An emotional moment takes place between Gopi and Billu as they celebrate the auspicious occasion of Raksha Bandhan. Parents arrive in the Chowky to solve their Daughter's marriage problem. Mother and father both have selected two different grooms for their daughter. How will Chautala solve Sunita's problem? Will Sunita marry Ramesh Goyal or Ramesh Gupta?

videos.title: Gopi's Close Friend Satvinder
videos.overview: Gopi's plan to get a holiday by lying to meet his close friend Satvinder flops as Chautala makes Gopi confess that he does not have any such friend. Bajrang is hit accidently by Gopi on his head and suffers from temporary amnesia. Chautala revives his memory. Later a colony watchman comes with a person named Sharma. He files a complaint against Sharma for beating him every morning. Later Chautala finds out from Sharma the reason behind the beating.

videos.title: Bajrang Ki Mamiji
videos.overview: Bajrang requests Chautala to cool down as his Mami is arriving from his village to check Bajrang's post  as someone has spread a rumour that he is a Constable. Gopi and Billu, like always, are again late in office. How will Bajrang stop Chautala from getting angry?

videos.title: Pyaar Ka Popcorn
videos.overview: Sanju and his Wife Simi lodge a police complaint against Seema and also share their problem. Simi tells Chandramukhi that her husband is shocked after watching a romantic movie Pyaar Ka Popcorn. Will the owner of the DVD shop Babloo land in deep trouble? What is their secret?

videos.title: Deewana Becomes a Huge Pain For Cinema Owner
videos.overview: Cinema owner lodges a police complaint against Deewana who started destroying his cinema. Deewana is extremely fond of suspense movies. Deewana reveals to Chautala that he stopped the screening of the movie when the suspense was about to be revealed. How will Chautala solve the case?

videos.title: Secret Of Expensive Painting
videos.overview: The most expensive painting gets sold for Rs. 4 Crore. Manager of Tasveer Tanatan Exhibition reveals to Chautala that her face is similar to the girl which appears in the most expensive painting. The painting is painted by Manhoos Manchanda. What is the secret of the most expensive painting? Who is the thief?

videos.title: Bunty Bhaiyya's Master Plan
videos.overview: Pushpa files a police complaint against her husband Anand Amarpremi's younger brother Bunty. Bunty made Anand Aamarpremi sign on all the property papers without informing Pushpa. Will Bunty land in deep trouble? Why did Bunty fool Anand Aamarpremi?

videos.title: Tunnu Tandon Ki Bike
videos.overview: Coach Tunnu Tandon files a police complaint against his mechanic for destroying his bike. Mechanic reveals to Chautala that he found sugar in the petrol and he didn't destroy his bike. Chautala reveals her plan to Mechanic and Tunnu. Tunnu's students get caught and reveals a shocking truth. Will she find the main culprit? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Criminal Chapadganju In Imaan Chowki
videos.overview: Commissioner asks Inspector Chautala to stay alert as a deadly criminal Chapadganju in on the loose. Chapadganju isn't scared of the inspector and warns her. Gopi and Billu overhear the inspector's conversation with Chapadganju when she is indirectly talking about ways to get out of jail.

videos.title: Mr. Tatola Ka Tota
videos.overview: Kangal Bank at the Chapadganju chowk gets robbed. Meanwhile, Lallan and Lalli Khatola register a FIR against their neighbour's parrot named Tatola. How will the inspector deal with the situation. Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Billu's Bucket Challenge to Gopi
videos.overview: A letter arrives at the station saying that every chief inspector's face will be inked in the coming days. Bajrang Pandey meets with an accident and breaks both his arms. Another letter arrives that says Bajrang's face will be inked the next day. Chakli comes to the chowky with a complain about a monkey who wants to marry her.

videos.title: Inspector Gora Becomes Kala
videos.overview: Chakli is worried about the monkey and Chautala suggests that she stay at the station till they can solve the case. Inspector finds some clues to the ink and tracks down the man who makes them. The inspector comes back to the station to a surprise.

videos.title: 3 Monkey Thieves In Raawanpur
videos.overview: Kishore and Kishori arrive at the station to register FIR against three monkeys who robbed their house. Inspector Chautala questions the manager of a circus about the monkey they had and couldn't find any leads. Mrs. Pammi Walia, wife of a scientist, informs the team that his husband has a formula that makes people beahve like animals.

videos.title: Gopi, Billu and Gulgule Get Caught By Monkeys

videos.overview: Billu tries to feed a plastic samosa to Gopi. Gopi becomes really angry and decides not to talk to Billu ever again. Billu tries to apologize but Gopi does not agree. Soon, Gopi witnesses Billu die in front of his very eyes and becomes very emotional. What will happen now?

videos.title: Gazal Kumar
videos.overview: Gazal Kumar files a complaint against two of his fans who every time disrupts his performances by appreciating him too violently. Chandramukhi  warns them off. The next day, Gazal Kumar comes and informs Chandramukhi  that he lost his job and the job is given to one of the fans. Chandramukhi  decides that she must teach them a lesson.

videos.title: Muh Kaala
videos.overview: A professor files complaint, claiming that someone blackened his face. Chandramukhi  gets dhobi to test the colour, and finds that the colour is some chemical that will not wash off. Just then, Gopi sees two girls in college laughing at professor. What will happen now?

videos.title: Half-moustache
videos.overview: A man comes to the Chowki and tells Chandramukhi  that his barber cut off his half moustache and because of it he has been relieved from his fathers will. The man s fiancee is brought to the Chowki for questioning, and she explains that as the man is no longer wealthy her mother called off her engagement. Will Chandramukhi  be able to help the poor man?

videos.title: Gappu and Chappu
videos.overview: Gappu and Chappu launches a complaint against a kuli who always puts Gappu on another train and disrupts his day on purpose. The kuli denies this infornt of Chandramukhi and claims the two are lying. Will the team be able to get to the bottom of this mystery? Watch this episode to find out now!
